articles.title: Bombay HC quashes FIR against Pune student over Operation Sindoor repost
articles.summary: The criminal law cannot be set into motion merely because a particular publication is perceived to be offensive, unless conduct falls within the prohibition prescribed by law, said Bombay High Court Justice Milind Jadhav and quashed an FIR lodged last year against a Pune engineering student for re-posting of a social media content related to Operation Sindoor.

articles.title: Bag dropped at murder spot leads cops to Muradnagar road rage accused
articles.summary: A 24-year-old man was arrested for allegedly stabbing a 32-year-old man to death following a road rage incident earlier this month in Muradnagar on Tuesday. Police scanned multiple CCTV camera footage over the last 17 days to trace the suspect through a shoulder bag that he had allegedly dropped at the crime spot during a scuffle.

articles.title: Bihar records high share of cybercrime cases driven by personal revenge
articles.summary: Data from the National Crime Records Bureau shows Bihar accounted for over sixty percent of revenge-driven cybercrimes nationwide in 2024. Officials and recent police reports reveal an increase in individuals using digital platforms, social media, and artificial intelligence tools to retaliate against former partners and acquaintances following personal disputes or relationship breakdowns.
articles.title_hi: व्यक्तिगत प्रतिशोध से प्रेरित साइबर अपराध के मामलों में बिहार की हिस्सेदारी अधिक है

articles.title: Assembly signs off with 8 resolutions; Mann bets on AAP repeat
articles.summary: On the concluding day of what Punjab Vidhan Sabha Speaker Kultar Singh Sandhwan described as “technically its last session” under the AAP-led govt, the Punjab Assembly on Tuesday passed eight resolutions, including five related to the state’s river-water rights, control of key irrigation headworks, the Dam Safety Act, 2021, and recovery of water charges from Rajasthan.

articles.title: Bihar: BJP’s NP Singh wins Tirhut Teachers’ MLC seat by 594 votes
articles.summary: NP Singh secured 2,945 votes in the final elimination round, while independent candidate Bhushan Jha finished second with 2,351 votes. Sanjay Singh, a two-term MLC who had represented the constituency, slipped to third place. The counting took place at the divisional headquarters in Muzaffarpur. During the first-preference vote count, BJP candidate NP Singh established a lead of 138 votes.

articles.title: PM Modi, Liechtenstein's Prince Alois hold talks focusing on trade, technology and talent
articles.summary: He is accompanied by his spouse Princess Sophie and a business delegation comprising several top industry leaders. Secretary (West) in the Ministry of External Affairs, Sibi George, said at a media briefing that Modi and Alois explored ways to enhance bilateral ties in areas of trade and investment, advanced manufacturing, technology, innovation, financial services, agriculture, space, education, and skills development.

articles.title: Bihar MLC Polls: Narendra Prasad Singh Wins Tirhut Teachers' Constituency By 594 Votes
articles.summary: BJP candidate Narendra Prasad Singh, representing the NDA, has won the seat by 594 votes. Narendra Prasad Singh secured 2,945 votes, defeating Independent candidate Bhushan Jha, who received 2,351 votes. CPI candidate Sanjay Singh finished third with 1,967 votes. Singh appeared delighted after the victory, with supporters lifting him onto their shoulders to celebrate.

articles.title: Ladakh Chief Secretary calls for wider consultations on demand for complete liquor ban
articles.summary: SRINAGAR: Amid growing demands from women’s representatives and religious organisations for a complete liquor ban in Ladakh, Chief Secretary Ashish Kundra on Tuesday called for wider consultations with stakeholders, including religious and industry leaders, before taking a decision. He stressed the need to balance the region’s social and cultural concerns with its tourism-dependent economy.

articles.title: Cabinet approves purchase of paddy field to expand Knowledge City
articles.summary: After the cabinet meeting on Tuesday ( Oct 27), the MDA spokesperson Wailadmiki Shylla said the government approved the purchase of an additional 2,81,000 sq. ft. of paddy field land at Mawkhanu, New Shillong, to fill gaps between previously acquired plots and facilitate the integrated development of Knowledge City. The land will be purchased at Rs 490 per sq.

articles.title: Bihar Partners With 11 IT Companies to Train Government School Teachers in AI
articles.summary: Bihar’s Education Department has partnered with 11 information technology companies to provide specialised training in artificial intelligence and digital skills to government school teachers. The initiative aims to improve teachers’ technology skills and prepare them to incorporate digital tools into classroom teaching. Google Education is among the organisations named in reports about the programme.

articles.title: Cyclone Arnab: Andhra Pradesh evacuates 89,000 people as state prepares for landfall
articles.summary: Authorities have evacuated at least 89,000 people from vulnerable coastal areas of Andhra Pradesh as Cyclone Arnab intensified over the Bay of Bengal and was expected to make landfall early Wednesday, AP reported. The India Meteorological Department classified Arnab as a " very severe " cyclonic storm, warning of heavy rainfall and strong winds along the east coast.

articles.title: Left Microsoft job, built Rs 4,000-crore 'Razorpay': How Shashank Kumar went from software
articles.summary: Shashank Kumar had a software development job at Microsoft after graduating from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Roorkee. But the engineer from Patna eventually left the technology giant to address a problem he encountered while exploring a business idea with his college friend, Harshil Mathur: making online payments easier for Indian startups and small businesses.

articles.title: Kochi Hit-and-Run Case: Police Raid Judge’s Residence as Probe Intensifies | Breaking News
articles.summary: Kochi Hit-and-Run Case: Police Raid Judge’s Residence as Probe Intensifies | Kerala NewsThe investigation into the fatal Kochi hit-and-run case has intensified, with a police team conducting a search at the residence of an Additional District Judge, whose minor son is accused in the crash. Investigators are also collecting CCTV footage as they examine the circumstances surrounding the accident.

articles.title: Will Israel witness a Bihar, Karnataka like power-sharing deal
articles.summary: Benjamin Netanyahu could finish behind Gadi Eisenkot in Israel's October 27 election but still return as prime minister through a unity government with a rotating premiership. With Donald Trump backing him and neither bloc projected to secure a majority, Netanyahu's political future might depend on whether his rival agrees to share power.

articles.title: Strict organized crime law invoked against accused in firing case
articles.summary: The city crime branch has invoked the Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act against the accused individuals in the Tiger Shroff firing case. Authorities cited the suspects' criminal backgrounds, financial motives, and a fight for supremacy. This legal step was taken by investigators to address the organized nature of the crime and prevent further escalation.

articles.title: Bihar MLC election results: JDU’s Neeraj Kumar leads in Patna amid commotion outside
articles.summary: The JDU candidate currently has about 2708 votes. Trailing behind him are RJD’s Dilip Patel with 1811 votes and Jansuraj Party's Anuj Singh with 671.
